definitions.explanation: Running away to avoid capture, punishment, or danger. Often used in serious contexts such as crime, war, or political persecution.

examples.japanese: ⟦{容疑者|ようぎしゃ}→容疑者：15039_yougisha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{逃亡|とうぼう}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{戦争|せんそう}→戦争：01450_sensou⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{逃亡|とうぼう}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{隣国|りんごく}→隣国：19116_ringoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{渡|わた}った→渡る：02441_wataru⟧。
examples.english: They fled the war and crossed into the neighboring country.

examples.japanese: {逃亡|とうぼう}⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{続|つづ}け→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧て⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦{犯人|はんにん}→犯人：03572_hannin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、{十年|じゅうねん}⟦ぶり→〜ぶり：28358_buri⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{逮捕|たいほ}→逮捕：03397_taiho⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The criminal, who had been living on the run, was arrested for the first time in ten years.

notes:
USAGE:
{逃亡|とうぼう} implies serious flight — running from the law, escaping persecution, or deserting. It has a heavier tone than ⟦{逃|に}げる→逃げる：01151_nigeru⟧ (to run away) and is common in news reporting.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- から{逃亡|とうぼう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to flee from...)
- ⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧{逃亡|とうぼう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to flee to...)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {逃亡|とうぼう}⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧ (life on the run)
- {逃亡|とうぼう}{中|ちゅう} (on the run, at large)
- {逃亡|とうぼう}{者|しゃ} (fugitive)
- {逃亡|とうぼう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{図|はか}る→図る：12006_hakaru⟧ (to attempt to flee)
- ⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{逃亡|とうぼう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to flee abroad)
